A chronological record of questions asked about a 300 mm span foam glider optimised for minimum sink rate in trimmed glide. Each **chapter**
is one model — a vehicle, a fidelity, a method — and each **entry** is one
question asked of it, answered by code that runs when the page renders.

## How the chapters relate

Chapters are numbered in the order they were written, which is not the order they
depend on each other. A chapter whose model was copied from an earlier one says
so at the top of its `_model.py`, and that is what this is drawn from — so the
picture cannot disagree with the models.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
# GENERATED FROM THE MODELS, never drawn by hand (rule 34 keeps this block here).
#
# Reads source, executes none of it: no chapter model is imported or solved, so
# this page stays free to render and has no cross-chapter value dependency.
# `create_chapter` deletes this page's freeze when it scaffolds a chapter,
# because rule 12 cannot -- the root index belongs to no chapter, so nothing
# else would notice a seventh node was missing.
import pathlib
import re

_FORK = re.compile(r"^#\s*Forked from chapters/([^/\s]+)/_model\.py", re.M)
_TITLE = re.compile(r'^title:\s*"(.+)"\s*$', re.M)

_chapters = sorted(p for p in pathlib.Path("chapters").iterdir() if p.is_dir())
_titles, _parent = {}, {}
for _c in _chapters:
    _index = _c / "index.qmd"
    _m = _TITLE.search(_index.read_text()) if _index.exists() else None
    _titles[_c.name] = _m.group(1) if _m else _c.name
    _model = _c / "_model.py"
    # Only the header, and only a parent that still exists: a fork line naming a
    # renamed chapter should leave a root node rather than a dangling edge.
    _f = _FORK.search(_model.read_text()[:2000]) if _model.exists() else None
    if _f and (pathlib.Path("chapters") / _f.group(1)).is_dir():
        _parent[_c.name] = _f.group(1)

_id = lambda s: "c" + re.sub(r"[^0-9A-Za-z]", "", s)
print("```{mermaid}")
print("graph TD")
for _c in _chapters:
    print(f'  {_id(_c.name)}["{_titles[_c.name]}"]')
    print(f"  click {_id(_c.name)} \"chapters/{_c.name}/index.html\"")
for _c in _chapters:
    if _c.name in _parent:
        print(f"  {_id(_parent[_c.name])} --> {_id(_c.name)}")
print("```")
```
